status: collection complete; 200 cases frozen from all eight qualified government sources before provider requests
selection_contract: Download and retain the exact source bytes, access timestamp, source URL, license text, and sha256 before selecting records.

Filter only by source fields: active status, dense-city boundary, allowed POI family, non-empty official name, stable source record ID, and valid coordinates. Never query a compared provider during selection.
Within each source and family, sort eligible records by sha256(source_plan_id + NUL + source_record_id) and review in that order until the quota is filled.

Reject tourist icons, generic unnamed facilities, duplicate branches, records whose official status cannot be confirmed, and records whose source coordinate is visibly an administrative centroid. Retain every rejection and reason.
For projected coordinates, retain the original values, source CRS, transformation command and version, and transformed WGS84 values.
Freeze the 200 cases and their case-file sha256 before the first Overture, Nominatim, or Photon request.
Do not geocode a source address with Overture, Nominatim, Photon, Google, or another compared or closed provider to manufacture gold coordinates.
If any source is found to be OSM-derived, mark osm_derived=true and make its cases Overture-only before measurement.

sources.city_filter: Tainan dense urban core: Zhongxi, East, North, South, and Anping districts
sources.publisher: Taiwan Tourism Administration, Ministry of Transportation and Communications
sources.qualification: The official catalog documents daily spatial restaurant data, identifiers, names, WGS84 coordinates, and the stated open-government license. The frozen 2026-08-03 snapshot contains no Taipei rows, so collection uses its 237 active named point records in Tainan's five core districts.
Collapse exits by STATION_NA, then use the lowest natural EXIT_CODE as the deterministic source point and retain that exit's OBJECTID.

sources.source_name: 新宿区の医療機関一覧
sources.qualification: The planned 2020 MLIT source explicitly includes suspended facilities and was not admitted. The replacement official Shinjuku municipal-standard dataset was updated 2025-12-12 and contains 695 current clinic rows with 695 unique stable ID values, Japanese names, addresses and valid points under CC BY 4.0. Selection requires a Japanese-script query surface and rejects duplicate names and one temporary vaccination site.

sources.source_license: Korea Open Government Licence Type 1 (attribution; commercial use and modification permitted)
sources.qualification: The official catalog is updated daily and explicitly documents EPSG:5174 coordinates. Its unauthenticated 1,000-row sheet preview contains the complete 929-row dataset, stable MGTNO licensing identifiers, and explicit trade/detailed status fields; conversion to WGS84 is pinned to pyproj 3.7.2 / PROJ 9.5.1 and retained with each case.

sources.source_name: Hospital Authority hospitals, institutions and clinics directory
sources.qualification: The official quarterly CSDI GeoJSON carries stable OBJECTID values, bilingual names, WGS84 points, and LASTUPDATE timestamps. Prefer the Traditional Chinese name as the query surface and retain English only as an accepted alias.

sources.source_name: Red adscrita de salud para Bogota D.C.
sources.qualification: The official district catalog and live ArcGIS layer expose CC BY 4.0 metadata, stable ID and OBJECTID values, provider status and point geometry. The frozen layer contains 117 unique IDs and names, of which 116 have valid Bogota points.

sources.source_name: Directorio Estadistico Nacional de Unidades Economicas (DENUE) 05_2026
sources.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadistica y Geografia
sources.qualification: The corrected official 05/2026 Ciudad de Mexico bulk snapshot contains 462,732 active establishments with unique DENUE id and CLEE values. Fixed establishments are classified from official SCIAN activity codes: 721 for lodging and 46 for retail. Exact source, methodology, correction notice and free-use terms are retained; selection excludes generic and duplicate names and points outside the frozen dense-city bounds.

sources.source_name: Business establishments with address and industry classification (2024)
sources.qualification: The official City of Melbourne 2024 snapshot contains 19,672 establishments with stable Opendatasoft recordid values, names, addresses, ANZSIC classifications, WGS84 coordinates and CC BY 4.0 licensing. Physical retail is limited to ANZSIC divisions 39-42 before deterministic review.
